meta.title: Ramses Martínez | Kingdom — Textile Design, Industrial Embroidery & Sublimation
meta.description: Textile design studio & industrial embroidery digitizing by Ramses Martínez in Barquisimeto, Venezuela. Optimized DST/PES stitch files, athletic sublimation and streetwear graphics.
meta.ogTitle: Ramses Martínez | Kingdom — Textile Design & Embroidery
meta.ogDesc: Textile design, industrial embroidery digitizing and made-to-order athletic sublimation.

hero.lead: Developing sublimated sportswear, custom apparel and industrial embroidery files (DST/PES) calibrated for fabric elasticity and machine efficiency.

about.title: Ramses Martínez × Kingdom
about.desc: Immersed in the textile trade since childhood and working professionally since age 18. Kingdom brings together my practice in embroidery digitizing, vector art and made-to-order manufacturing.

timeline.title: Family Workshop Heritage
timeline.desc: Growing up around sewing machines, pattern drafting and embroidery threads, understanding fabric behavior from hands-on craft.

timeline.title: Industrial Embroidery Digitizing
timeline.desc: Advanced punching and DST/PES file preparation, calibrating stitch density, underlays, pull-compensation and sequence logic.

timeline.title: Kingdom — Design & Production
timeline.desc: Independent design practice producing sublimated jerseys, streetwear graphics and digital file preparation for global apparel makers.

services.title: Digital & Physical Solutions
services.desc: Digital services are available worldwide; physical garments are made to order with delivery lead times based on project scope.

items.title: Embroidery Digitizing DST / PES
items.body: Technical punching with fabric pull-compensation, calibrated density and clean sequences designed to minimize thread breaks in production.

items.title: Full Print Sports Sublimation
items.body: Scaled pattern templates and color profile calibration for performance fabrics (Dry-Fit, microfibers and technical polyester).

items.title: Vector Illustration & Streetwear
items.body: Original character illustrations, logo vectorization and color separations for screen printing or DTF transfers on cotton and blends.

materials.title: Technical Specifications
